name: Teardrop trailer
definition: small towed living trailer with a teardrop profile, a sleeping cabin and a rear-hatch galley, without standing room inside.
reason: RV dealers list teardrops as their own type; no standing interior, so not a touring caravan; folding camper does not fold.

name: Stroller wagon
definition: wheeled box-bodied carrier with harnessed seats for two or more children, pushed like a stroller or pulled by a handle.
reason: Box body with facing seats differs from a double stroller; sold as its own type (Wonderfold, Keenz).

name: Flats and bay boat
definition: shallow-draft open saltwater fishing boat with a poling or casting platform, made for bays and tidal flats.
reason: Shops list bay and flats boats apart from offshore sport-fishing and bass boats; shallow-draft inshore form.

name: River raft
definition: inflatable open boat of large tubes, paddled or rowed by a group, made for whitewater rivers.
reason: A distinct tube-boat hull sold as rafts; inflatable kayaks stay kayaks (G-8).

name: Paramotor (powered paraglider)
definition: backpack engine and propeller worn by a foot-launched pilot under a paraglider wing.
reason: Foot-launched, no cart, so not a powered parachute; motor makes it G1 (P1 logic), as unpowered paragliders are E2.

parent: G2.1.8 Other land by principal use (new leaf)
name: parking space
definition: a bay or space for parking a vehicle held as land (freehold or long lease); a rented bay or permit is OUT.
reason: Settles the memo's open freehold-bay kind (K-67, G2.1 Land); Rightmove sells Parking as its own type; no Land leaf fits.

parent: G2.1.8 Other land by principal use (new leaf)
name: campsite
definition: land laid out and held for camping, touring pitches or glamping units, with or without amenity buildings.
reason: Principal use is camping (G-12: LandSale filter stops here); no Land leaf holds leisure uses; pitches are not a dwelling.

parent: G2.1.8 Other land by principal use (new leaf)
name: solar farm
definition: land whose principal use is a ground-mounted photovoltaic array, sold with or as a site for it.
reason: LandSale type; principal use energy generation, no existing Land leaf; panels as installed equipment go with the site.

parent: G2.1.8 Other land by principal use (new leaf)
name: wind farm
definition: land whose principal use is wind turbines for power generation, sold with or as a site for them.
reason: LandSale type; principal use energy generation; a lease of the site to an operator is a right (OUT).

parent: G2.1.8 Other land by principal use (new leaf)
name: golf course
definition: land laid out as a golf course, with or without a clubhouse (`improvements`).
reason: A use of the ground, not a motive (unlike the recreational tag); LandSale filter; no Land leaf fits.

parent: G2.1.8 Other land by principal use (new leaf)
name: airstrip
definition: land laid out as a runway or landing strip for light aircraft, with or without hangars (`improvements`).
reason: LandSale type; principal use of the ground is aviation; no Land leaf fits.

name: manual blood-pressure kit
definition: gauge with arm cuff and hand bulb, read by listening with a stethoscope (aneroid sphygmomanometer, with or without stethoscope).
reason: Needs a stethoscope and skill; form and use differ from automatic monitors (C10 b). Logged page does not show it: HV_NK attests.

name: peak flow meter
definition: handheld tube with a scale that measures how fast a person can breathe out, used to monitor asthma.
reason: Every monitor is H2.1 (H-9); no leaf measures lung function, so new leaf H2.1.9. No logged page shows it: HV_NK attests.

name: HbA1c home test kit
definition: one-use kit that measures average blood glucose (HbA1c) from a fingerstick blood sample.
reason: Measures its own quantity; not a meter or strip; tests are H2.1 (H-9). No logged page shows it: HV_NK attests.

name: steam inhaler
definition: device that makes warm steam to be breathed in for cold, cough or sinus relief, without liquid medicine.
reason: Steam, not a medicine mist, so the nebuliser definition fails. Harvester saw Beurer SI30; logged summary omits it: HV_NK attests.

name: electronic magnifier
definition: camera-and-screen device, handheld or desktop, that enlarges print and images for a low-vision user (video magnifier, CCTV).
reason: Camera and screen change the form (C10 b) from optical magnifiers. Harvester saw a nav link only: HV_NK attests.

name: fat burner
definition: thermogenic supplement sold to support fat loss alongside training.
reason: Sold in sports-nutrition ranges as its own type; role differs from pre-workout. Logged summary omits it: HV_NK attests.

name: protein snack
definition: snack other than a bar (chips, crisps, cookies) sold for its protein.
reason: Quest sells protein chips beside bars; a different product compared on its own. Logged summary omits it: HV_NK attests.

name: contact-lens rewetting drops
definition: drops put in the eye with lenses in place to rewet and soothe them.
reason: Used in the eye, not to clean or store lenses, so the solution definition fails. Logged summary omits it: HV_NK attests.
